The following is a summary of Conclave proceedings during the Spring Equinox 380YE.

==The Imperial Titles of the Conclave==
The full list of Imperial Titles held in the Conclave at the end of the Spring Equinox, 380YE  can be found under [[Archive:380YE_Spring_Equinox_Imperial_titles|380YE Spring Equinox Imperial titles]].

The following Imperial Titles were appointed by the Conclave during the Spring Equinox, 380YE:

*'''Mord of Auric Horizon''' became the new [[Archmage]] of Day.
* '''Pavel''' remained the [[Archmage]] of Night.
* '''Alcuin Shatterspire''' remained the [[Archmage]] of Spring.
